storyCards.headline: The Sweetest Taboo: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Sade's "The Sweetest Taboo" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "The Sweetest Taboo" is a song by English band Sade from their second studio album, Promise (1985).

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

The Sweetest Taboo was released in 1985.
